text:
jamie (support): pinging #support — BrightApp reports a surprise invoice jump after a burst of 502s earlier today. they sent logs and say tokens doubled for a handful of requests. can we triage?

jamie (support): logs from customer (sanitized):
```
req-id=2145678901-A POST /v1/completions 502 -> client timeout
headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, Idempotency: none
client: BrightApp SDK v1.2.3 auto-retry after 10s
ops-bot: ingress-gateway retried request 3 times for req-id=2145678901-A
```

alex (ingress): can you attach the request trace id from their side and whether an idempotency header was present?

jamie (support): the customer says SDK should populate idempotency but v1.2.3 had a regression for streaming endpoints — header name used was `Idempotency` (no x- prefix) instead of `X-Idempotency-Key`. looks like the header wasn't forwarded/recognized.

sam (infra): that would fit: our gateway normalization and idempotency lookup currently expects `x-idempotency-key`. if header name changed, backend sees it as a new request -> duplicate meter rows.

linda (billing): do we have ledger rows for both attempts? can you paste the meter lines?

jamie (support): ledger snippet: 
```
meter_row: id=lr-A customer=brightapp tokens=1234 request_id=2145678901-A
meter_row: id=lr-B customer=brightapp tokens=1230 request_id=2145678901-A-retry
```

linda (billing): yep that's two separate meter entries for same user/session. we can start a support credit but need trace ids/time window.

alex (ingress): mitigation: add a temporary header-normalization rule to map `Idempotency` -> `X-Idempotency-Key` and emit a debug log when non-standard header seen. also log when idempotency header is not forwarded.

sam (infra): i can push ingress patch to normalize headers. also proposing ingress validation: if POST and content-length>0 and streaming=false, require idempotency header or reject with 4xx to force clients to retry with correct header (safer for future).

jamie (support): repro steps from customer: use SDK v1.2.3 streaming=true, kill TCP before server response, SDK retries after 10s. repro local with curl: 
```
# simulate streaming timeout then resend without idempotency
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "Idempotency: 12345" -d '{"prompt":"hey","stream":true}' --max-time 9
# then resend same payload without idempotency -> server creates new meter row
```

alex (ingress): thanks. sam, can you backport SDK fix too? looks like two pieces: (1) gateway normalization (hotfix), (2) SDK patch to use `X-Idempotency-Key` consistently.

sam (infra): i'll pick up the gateway hotfix now (rolling deploy). i'll also coordinate with client-sdk team to release v1.2.4 with the header name fix.

linda (billing): billing will prepare a one-off credit for the duplicate token set. opening ticket to flag invoices in 2026-02-14 09:30-10:15 UTC and scan for similar duplicates.

ops-bot: deployment queued: ingress-gateway header-normalization patch -> rollout started to 5 hosts :rocket: 

jamie (support): BrightApp is ok with credit, wants rc and ETA for fix + brief RCA.

alex (ingress): ETA: infra hotfix 2h, SDK release EOD. will follow up with postmortem.

linda (billing): credit ID CR-9001 created; will do invoice adjustment once infra confirms duplicates window.

jamie (support): action items summary :thumbsup:
- sam: deploy ingress header normalization (2h)
- sam: coordinate SDK fix and release v1.2.4 (EOD)
- linda: issue credit + invoice reconciliation (24h)
- jamie: send incident summary & RCA to BrightApp

sam (infra): ack.
linda (billing): ack.
ops-bot: ingress-gateway rollout in progress, 2/5 hosts updated.
jamie (support): closing after customer confirmation.
